sections.heading: 1. Seated rotation
lines: ① Sit tall and cross your arms over your chest.
② Turn slowly side to side, 10 each way.
③ Lean back over your chair: 5 gentle extensions.

sections.heading: 2. Call 000 if…
lines: Back pain with chest pain or breathlessness,
or sweating? Skip the drill and call 000.

slides.title: When to see your GP
slides.bubble:

slides.heading: Book a GP visit if you notice

caption:
Mr Turtle's upper back aches like something is burning between his shoulder blades. Hours driving, at a desk or on the phone keep it in one spot, and stress and shallow breathing often add to it.

Hybi's 1-minute unlock: sit tall, arms crossed, turn slowly 10 times each way, then 5 gentle extensions over the back of your chair, 3–4 times a day. Lying on a rolled towel after work is another easy option.

Upper back pain with chest pain, breathlessness or sweating needs urgent care, so call 000. Night pain or weight loss is worth a GP visit. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help too. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
